name: Red-Team Scam - Urgent Bank OTP Extortion (English)

caller_script.text: Hello, this is Inspector Rathore from HDFC Bank Central Security. An unauthorized transaction of 75,000 rupees was just attempted on your pension account.
Your account will be permanently blocked within 10 minutes unless we verify your identity right now.
I have just sent a 6-digit one-time password to your mobile number. Read out the OTP code immediately to reverse the fraud charge!
Why are you hesitating? Give me the 6 digits right now or you will lose all the money in your savings account!
